ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) surface with a macro-level ratio of approximately 0.05:1 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white linear/mottled streak located on the inner-medial region of the left lobe. Discrete white focal spots are clustered along the boundary of the median notch and sparsely on the right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 75 degrees and a depth of approximately 15% of the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) along the continuous linear boundary; notable deep irregular serrations on the distal half of the left lobe and jagged serrations along the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the upper outer edges of both fluke lobes, tapering to distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of small, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters near the median notch and lower right lobe margin, consistent with barnacle scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, unaligned diagonal linear white pixel disruption located on the medial section of the left lobe, breaking the dark pigmentation mapping.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch/missing tissue on the distal trailing edge of the left lobe; multiple jagged notches and potential old trauma marks along the margins of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The prominent diagonal white streak on the inner-left lobe serves as a highly unique visual marker.
